questions.question: Explain how the Reichstag Fire helped Hitler consolidate power. (4 marks)

points.text: The Reichstag Fire (27 February 1933) allowed Hitler to persuade Hindenburg to issue the Reichstag Fire Decree (28 February), which suspended civil liberties including freedom of speech, assembly, and the press. questions.question: How important was the Enabling Act in the establishment of the Nazi dictatorship? (8 marks)

points.text: The Enabling Act (23 March 1933) was critically important because it gave Hitler the power to make laws without the Reichstag for four years. This single law destroyed the Weimar Constitution and created the legal basis for dictatorship. questions.question: "Hitler consolidated power through legal means rather than violence." How far do you agree? (16 marks)

points.text: Hitler used a combination of legal and violent methods. Legal methods included: the Reichstag Fire Decree (signed by Hindenburg); the Enabling Act (passed by the Reichstag); laws banning parties and trade unions; and the plebiscite of August 1934.
